title: Worst Lid
text: Worst Lid. I love the color of this tumbler. I really like the size, as well. I hate the lid. It is awkward to drink from. It rotates to open and close, but has to be disassembled to wash because the drink gets between the two layers. I only use this cup with a straw because I dislike drinking from the lid. I have a smaller size and have the exact same issue. I always end up with coffee all over my shirt from this lid of I attempt to drink from it. This is the worst lid for stainless steel cups that I have ever used.

product_metadata.title: BUILT 30 Ounce Double Walled Stainless Steel Tumbler Coral 5236691
features: GREAT FOR HOT AND COLD: The double-wall construction ensures both hot or cold drinks can be kept at optimum temperature for longer. It can keep your drinks cold for 24+ hours or hot for 8 hours.

ONE-HANDED DRINKING: Threadless, transparent Tritan lid easily slides open and closed for a one handed operation and helps to prevent against spills. Features a convenient drinking hole for sipping for beverage or placement for your straw.
DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: Made of high quality food grade 18/8 stainless steel, double wall vacuum-sealed construction which helps to prevent condensation from foaming on the outside of the bottle.
EASY TO CLEAN: Designed for easy and convenient cleaning. The Tritan lid separates into two parts making it super easy to clean. Hand Wash Recommended for body and lid
CAR CUP FRIENDLY: The tumbler stands 8.58" tall and has a diameter of 3.82" which makes it size perfectly to fit in standard sized cup holders.
STRESSLESS DRINKING: This tumbler is Food and Lead Safety tested plus it’s PVC, BPA, latex and phthalate-free; 30 fluid ounce capacity.

SUSTAINABILITY: Every year, billions of pounds of waste ends up in the oceans, and a vast majority of this trash is plastic meaning it will take thousands of years to decompose. Reusable water bottles are a convenient and environmentally friendly solution
description: This BYO Double Wall Tumbler is an ideal choice for a chilled or infused water but also just as suited to hold a warm hot chocolate or coffee for the commute. It can keep your drinks cold for 24+ hours or hot for 6 hours. The threadless lid has been molded from Tritan, a hard wearing and reliable plastic which will not fail you on your busy day. Effortlessly slide open or closed with one-hand, making drinking on-the-go a breeze. The main body of the tumbler has been crafted from double-wall stainless steel. The double-wall construction ensures both hot or cold drinks can be kept at optimum temperature for longer. The Tritan lid separates into two parts for easy cleaning. Hand-wash with warm water and a mild detergent; rinse and dry immediately. Sized to fit in most standard cup holders. Food and Lead Safety tested plus it’s PVC, BPA, latex and phthalate-free and holds 30 ounces. With every BYO reusable tumbler purchased, you save money, keep hydrated and reduce plastic waste.
